heroIntro: I'm {age} years old. I'm into electronics, mechanics, and technology. I love fixing things, designing them, and contributing to open-source projects.
story1: When I was little, I apparently spent a whole day trying to fix an alarm clock. Whether I actually managed it, I can't remember.
story2: In primary school I was class president. One day, when our teacher had to step out of the classroom, she sat me down at the computer. I didn't even know how to scroll with a trackpad.
j1d: When everyone had to stay indoors, school moved online. That's when we got our first computer and home internet. Ever since, I've been busy with technology and with building things that help people.
j2d: A motherboard fault made my laptop shut down constantly. We took it in for repair again and again, but it never got fixed.
j3d: When it came back from repair it was still broken, and everything on it had been erased: my projects, our videos, and my childhood photos. We were only able to recover 40–50 photos, from my cousins.
j4d: I back everything up now. Since I don't have a computer, I make designs on my phone and contribute Turkish translations to open-source apps. I'm saving up for a new computer.
memSub: A few childhood snapshots that survived after I lost my data.
alt1: Little Hasan laughing with a red bucket on his head

cap1: A bucket on my head and a huge grin on my face.
cap2: Something in my hands again: maybe broken, maybe waiting to be fixed.
cap3: Birthday cake and time to make a wish.
